messages.content:
Several readers answered the same question about machines at work, each pointing at the sentences it
used. Decide which answer the evidence supports. Use only the evidence shown; do not use what you know.

Rules:
- An answer is supported only if its evidence states it for the exact subject asked about (the same device, the
  same article and paragraph, the same kind of verification, the same deadline, the same condition the question
  states). Evidence about a neighbouring subject does not support an answer.
- When answers rest on texts of different rank, the higher rank wins: law, then guidance, then manufacturer's
  manual, then company procedure, then plant record. Between two Italian texts, a legislative decree (D.Lgs.)
  wins over a ministerial decree (DM). A wording corrected by a corrigendum replaces the original wording.
- For a list, prefer the answer whose items are each stated by the evidence and that leaves none out.
- Readers that found nothing are listed too: when most readers found nothing and the one answer shown rests on
  evidence about a neighbouring subject, choose "none".
Return JSON only: {"reasoning": "two or three short sentences", "choice": <the number of the answer supported, or "none">}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Under Article 71 of Legislative Decree 81/2008, who bears the cost of carrying out the periodic verifications of the lifting devices in the IGEA list?

Answer 1 (given by 1 reader(s): facts): "Il datore di lavoro: ai sensi dell'art. 71, comma 11, del D.Lgs. 81/2008, le spese delle verifiche periodiche sono poste a suo carico, poiché le verifiche sono effettuate a titolo oneroso."
Under Art. 71, comma 11, of Legislative Decree 81/2008, the employer (datore di lavoro) bears the cost of the periodic verifications, because they are carried out for a fee.
Evidence:
- datore di lavoro, costi delle verifiche: hasObligation = le spese per la loro effettuazione sono poste a carico del datore di lavoro (condition: Le verifiche di cui al presente comma sono effettuate a titolo oneroso) | sentence: "Le verifiche di cui al presente comma sono effettuate a titolo oneroso e le spese per la loro effettuazione sono poste a carico del datore di lavoro." [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 11]

Answer 2 (given by 1 reader(s): words): "The employer (datore di lavoro) bears the cost of the periodic verifications."
Under Article 71, comma 11 of D.Lgs. 81/2008, the verifications are paid for by the employer, and this applies to the IGEA lifting devices as Annex VII equipment. The IGEA service contract (Scheda Tecnica) sets the payment mechanism but does not change this legal allocation.
Evidence:
- Read on demand: DLGS71, art. 71, c. 11 | sentence: "Le verifiche di cui al presente comma sono effettuate a titolo oneroso e le spese per la loro effettuazione sono poste a carico del datore di lavoro." [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 11]

Answer 3 (given by 1 reader(s): similar): "The employer (datore di lavoro) bears the cost of the periodic verifications of the IGEA lifting devices."
Under Article 71, paragraph 11 of Legislative Decree 81/2008, the verifications are paid for by the employer (datore di lavoro), who is the party that commissions them for the IGEA lifting devices.
Evidence:
- Read on demand: DLGS71, art. 71, c. 11 | sentence: "Le verifiche di cui al presente comma sono effettuate a titolo oneroso e le spese per la loro effettuazione sono poste a carico del datore di lavoro." [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 11]
- Read on demand: igea-equipment, p. 3 | sentence: "verifica periodica (successiva alla prima) degli apparecchi di sollevamento di Igea S.p.A. secondo quanto previsto dall’ art.71 c. 11" [igea-equipment, p. 3]

Answer 4 (given by 1 reader(s): search): "The employer (datore di lavoro) bears the cost of the periodic verifications under Article 71, paragraph 11 of D.Lgs. 81/2008."
Under art. 71, comma 11 of D.Lgs. 81/2008, the periodic verifications of the Annex VII equipment, including the IGEA lifting devices, are paid services and their costs are charged to the employer (datore di lavoro).
Evidence:
- Found by search: DLGS71, art. 71, c. 11 | sentence: "Le verifiche di cui al presente comma sono effettuate a titolo oneroso e le spese per la loro effettuazione sono poste a carico del datore di lavoro." [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 11]
- Found by search: igea-equipment, p. 3 | sentence: "La presente Scheda Tecnica disciplina, in materia di aspetti tecnici, la verifica periodica (successiva alla prima) degli apparecchi di sollevamento di Igea S.p.A. secondo quanto previsto dall’ art.71 c. 11, modificato dalla Legge 98 del 9 agosto 2013, e dall’Allegato VII del D.Lgs. 81/08 e ss.mm.ii." [igea-equipment, p. 3]

Readers that found nothing: none

response.text: {"reasoning": "All four answers say the employer bears the cost, citing Art. 71 comma 11 of D.Lgs. 81/2008, which states that the verifications are paid for and costs are charged to the employer. The IGEA scheda tecnica confirms the lifting devices are covered by art. 71 c. 11, so the evidence matches the exact subject.", "choice": 4}
